summary: @CWDaly like most mine were Star Wars toys but these weren't originals. One's my brother and I collected from a flea market outside a market that was half Amish, some skinheads in the WWII shop, our two comic books stores, half local shop owners scraping by. Toys lost to basement flood. Amish Market is now The Home Depot
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@CWDaly like most mine were Star Wars toys but these weren't originals. One's my brother and I collected from a flea market outside a market that was half Amish, some skinheads in the WWII shop, our two comic books stores, half local shop owners scraping by.

Toys lost to basement flood.

Amish Market is now The Home Depot
